title: Constructivist
when: Manifestos, campaigns, launches with a cause, hard numbers stated as demands

voice.style: declarative and rousing, short sentences, no hedging

rules: Two inks and cream: red for the cause, black for the structure. A third colour only for a source line.
Everything leans: build on a diagonal (rotate the group -12° to -30°); circles and wedges collide; type runs along the slope. Start from the manifesto sketch.
Photographs become halftones in one ink: plate treatment halftone, or an image element with print {screen: dots, ink: ink}.
Numbers are slabs: one figure huge in the poster face, its unit small beside it, its source visible.
Cut hard on the stressed word; no dissolves. A wipe at a chapter turn is the only soft move.
